title: PMK 42/2022: selected vehicle PPnBM classes
summary: Encode eight passenger-vehicle CO2 branches and six other vehicle classes at the amended-annex date. Preserve import versus producer-supply bases, testing evidence, Ex. goods classifications and conditional low-carbon/exemption overrides. Do not infer unverified bus/double-cab or investment-triggered program numbers.
